claims: As of March 26, 2026, there are no major, immediate wildfires threatening the Washington DC area.
As of March 26, 2026, small brush fires are active in the region.
The Virginia Department of Forestry reports several small, active brush fires.
The Virginia Department of Forestry reports recent incidents in Charlottesville.
A small, 3-acre fire called the "Black Valley Road Fire" was reported in Bedford, PA, recently.
Dry conditions have led to high fire danger.
Active brush fires have been reported in nearby areas.
A 10-acre fire was reported in Chesterfield County, VA earlier in March.
Virginia’s "4 PM Burning Law" is in effect through April 30.
Virginia’s "4 PM Burning Law" prohibits open-air burning before 4 PM.
